title: The Isaacs-Navarro-Wolf conjecture
summary: The Isaacs--Navarro--Wolf conjecture states that if $G$ is a finite solvable group and $x$ is an element of $G$ such that $χ(x)$ does not vanish for all irreducible characters $χ$ of $G$, then $x$ must be contained in some nilpotent normal subgroup. In this paper we present a proof of the Isaacs--Navarro--Wolf conjecture that was discovered with the use of artificial intelligence systems.
